context:
COMMON GUARDRAILS (apply to every long-test item; violating any is a stop)
C1 Coverage parity: for every changed, merged or deleted test, record the executed lines under benchbox/, scripts/ and _project/ (coverage API or pytest-cov, COVERAGE_CORE=sysmon, run under pytest) before and after on the affected tests, both on the same base commit. For tests that execute code in a subprocess (run_cli_command CLI tests, explorer examples, pytest --collect-only), measure with a local coverage config adding `[run] patch = subprocess` and report subprocess-executed lines separately; an in-process-only measurement of a subprocess test is not parity evidence. Note that the trunk map uses ctrace with test contexts and attributes setup-phase (fixture) lines to the whole module. Every line lost must be executed by another named test in the same or a faster tier (show it), or be listed with a reason in the PR body. No unexplained loss.
C2 Mutation proof: any replaced or merged test, and any surviving test that is claimed to cover a deleted one, must fail on a deliberate throwaway break of the property it verifies. Record each mutation and result; never commit them; revert and confirm git status before committing.
C3 No green by weakening: no removed or loosened assertions (except deleting a whole duplicate test under C1/C2), no skip/xfail, no raised timeouts, no tier or marker moves unless this item's decision gate allows it, no mocking of the behaviour under test.
C4 Scope: change only the files this item names. Product code changes only where the item says so. No data-baseline, generator or known-divergence list changes unless named.
C5 Honest timing: label every number CI (named run) or local. Claim savings only as the summed junit time of every id in each touched module (and the shard wall time), from a named post-change CI run, against the same module sum in the baseline (tests/fixtures/medium_shard_durations.json, run 39538637499, or a named later run on the same base); per-id deltas are informational because shared fixture cost moves to the next test on the worker. Report what is unverified.
C6 Repository process: make worktree-create with a fix/ branch, make agent-write-preflight, explicit git add paths, ruff, make comment-policy-check (no explanatory comments or docstrings), the code review action as self-review before make pr-open, oracle review, arm only on the exact head with every required check green, no attribution trailers, durable text without session or tracker labels. Do not edit PR title or body after CI starts unless needed (use make pr-rerun to retry CI).
C7 Id bookkeeping: list every new, renamed or deleted test node id in the PR body; they have no history in the coverage map or medium_shard_durations.json until item longtest-16 refreshes them.
C8 Selection impact: state whether the change alters which lines a test executes (scale change, subprocess to in-process, merge), and therefore which PRs select it and its weight in the 900 s selection estimate.
C9 Evidence durability: put the coverage diff summary, mutation table and CI timing table in the PR body (not only /tmp).
C10 Stop rule: if a decision gate fails or evidence contradicts the plan, do not improvise a different design; record the finding in this item's context and leave the item open (or blocked) with the next action.

PROBLEM: tests/unit/core/tpcds/test_production_binding.py::TestSQLAndDataFrameBindTheSameValues::test_every_adapted_query runs four times (~45 s PR), about 310 dsqgen calls each; tests/unit/core/equivalence/test_tpcds_shared_draw.py builds a 27 s `draw` fixture about 8 times per trunk run, often for builder-refusal tests that only need seed/stream values; tests/integration/test_tpcds_obt_parameter_draws.py has 14 cases each rebuilding nothing but paying per-shard fixture cost (~40 s PR).

CHANGES:
1. test_every_adapted_query: parametrize over a new local list [(42, 0)] and leave the shared RUNS list unchanged (TestPowerParameterSeed and test_second_statement_variants use it).
2. test_tpcds_shared_draw builder-refusal tests: remove the draw dependency; use constant seed/stream values and {n: object() for n in range(1, 99)} for the binding case (the check compares keys only); run the implementation case once, not per draw. Keep test_all_103 unchanged.
3. test_tpcds_obt_parameter_draws: one test looping over the 14 queries with one query manager, asserting the list of queries that returned no rows is [] (message names failing ids).

DECISION GATES:
G1 For change 1, show a cover for each of (None,0), (None,1) and (42,1) (test_all_103 covers (None,0) and (42,1) per the review; find one for (None,1)); a run without a cover is kept, or its loss (one random draw) is listed under C1 and accepted in the PR body.
G2 For change 2, C2: break each refusal condition and show each builder test still fails as intended without the draw.
G3 For change 3, the looped test must stay under the 60 s default timeout on CI with margin (target < 40 s); if not, split into two halves instead.
G4 Profile the OBT fixture's transform (about 11 s locally, unexplained by cProfile, likely in DuckDB/native code); record where the time goes; change it only if a fix is local to the test fixture.
